end.lessonName: Locate a Place on a Map
end.chapter: The Earth as a Planet in the Solar System — Location and Time
end.topic: The Earth as a Planet in the Solar System
end.coverNote: Good morning, class. Today we do Practical Work 1: we locate places on a map with their latitude and longitude. Take out your atlases, rulers and pencils.
end.focus: Locating a place on a map using latitudes and longitudes; reading and writing geographical coordinates.
end.competence: Learners are able to find a place on a map from its coordinates, and to give the coordinates of towns such as Garoua, Maroua and Ngaoundéré.
objectives: Revise the meaning of latitude and longitude on a map.
Follow the steps to read the coordinates of a place.
Find a place on a map from its coordinates.
Give the coordinates of Cameroon and of some of its towns.
recall: A latitude measures the distance north or south of the Equator.
A longitude measures the distance east or west of the Prime Meridian.
We write the latitude first and the longitude second.
end.recallNote: Check that every pair of learners has an atlas and a ruler.
situation: A Red Cross team in Garoua must deliver medicines to a small village that is not on most phone maps. The head office sends a message with only two numbers: "10° N, 14° E".
The team has a large paper map of the North Region. They must find the exact place of the village on the map to plan their route.
sitQA: What is the problem raised in the situation above?
The problem is that the team must find the village on a paper map using only its coordinates.
What do the numbers "10° N, 14° E" represent?
They represent the latitude (10° North) and the longitude (14° East) of the village.
Near which town of the North Region is this village?
It is near Guider, north-east of Garoua.
end.justification: This practical work will help us to use a map to find places and to give their exact position.

qa.q: On a map, which lines run from left to right, and which lines run from top to bottom?
qa.a: Lines of latitude run from left to right (west to east). Lines of longitude run from top to bottom (north to south).

qa.q: Where are the values of latitude and longitude written on a map?
qa.a: The values of latitude are written on the left and right edges of the map. The values of longitude are written on the top and bottom edges.

sum.title: I. Revision of Key Ideas
sum.intro: On a map, the lines of latitude and longitude form a grid:
items: Lines of latitude run across the map from west to east. Their values are read on the left or right edge of the map (N or S).
Lines of longitude run from the top to the bottom of the map. Their values are read on the top or bottom edge (E or W).

qa.q: You want the coordinates of Garoua. What is the first step?
qa.a: The first step is to find Garoua on the map.

qa.q: How do you find the latitude of Garoua?
qa.a: From Garoua, I follow a line of latitude to the left or right edge of the map and read the value in degrees, with N or S.

qa.q: How do you find the longitude of Garoua?
qa.a: From Garoua, I follow a line of longitude to the top or bottom edge of the map and read the value in degrees, with E or W.

sum.title: II. Steps to Read Coordinates
sum.intro: To read the coordinates of a place, we follow four steps:
items: – Step 1: Find the place on the map.
– Step 2: Read its latitude on the left or right edge (N or S).
– Step 3: Read its longitude on the top or bottom edge (E or W).
– Step 4: Write the latitude first, then the longitude. Example: Garoua, 9° N, 13° E.

qa.title: Exercise A
qa.q: On the map of Africa, give the coordinates of the black dot in Cameroon.
qa.a: The black dot in Cameroon is at about 6° N, 12° E.

qa.title: Exercise B
qa.q: Between which latitudes and which longitudes is Cameroon located?
qa.a: Cameroon is located between about 2° N and 13° N, and between about 8° E and 16° E.

qa.title: Exercise C
qa.q: Give the coordinates of Garoua, Maroua and Ngaoundéré.
qa.a: Garoua: about 9°18′ N, 13°24′ E. Maroua: about 10°36′ N, 14°18′ E. Ngaoundéré: about 7°18′ N, 13°36′ E.

qa.title: Exercise D
qa.q: Which town is at about 3°52′ N, 11°31′ E? Which town is at about 4°03′ N, 9°42′ E?
qa.a: The first town is Yaoundé, the capital. The second town is Douala.

sum.title: III. Practical Exercises
sum.intro: We located Cameroon and some of its towns with the grid of the map:
items: Cameroon lies between about 2° N and 13° N, and between about 8° E and 16° E.

evaluation: On which edges of a map do we read the latitude?
We read the latitude on the left and right edges of the map.
Write the coordinates of Garoua in the correct order.
Garoua: about 9° N, 13° E (latitude first, then longitude).
A place is at 10° N, 14° E. Near which town of the North Region is it?
It is near Guider, north-east of Garoua.
remediation: Lines of ______ run from west to east on a map.
Lines of ______ run from north to south.
end.homework: Look at the time on a phone set to Cameroon time and on a phone or television showing the time in another country (for example Dubai or Brazil). Write both times and the difference.
end.homeworkTag: This prepares Lesson 4: Local Time, Standard Time and Time Zones.
teacherNote: Coordinates checked (rounded): Garoua 9.30° N, 13.40° E; Maroua 10.59° N, 14.32° E; Ngaoundéré 7.32° N, 13.58° E; Yaoundé 3.87° N, 11.52° E; Douala 4.05° N, 9.70° E.
Correction: the point 10° N, 14° E is near Guider (North Region), not on the border with Chad. Cameroon extends from about 1°40′ N to 13° N and from about 8°30′ E to 16°10′ E.
Explain that 1 degree = 60 minutes (′) before Exercise C.
references: National Geography Syllabus (MINESEC), Form 4 — The Earth as a Planet in the Solar System.
